description: Coercion contingency completed, plus a vague agreement and reinforcement erosion.
transcript:
A: Can you call the plumber today? I need you to stop putting it off.
B: No. I am not the one who has to fix everything around here.
A: I am going to keep bringing this up until you do it.
B: Fine, I'll call. Whatever you want.
A: You should be home by seven as well.
B: I'll try.
A: That used to matter to me. Now it doesn't count anymore.
B: I can't win either way, can I.

gold.notes: Patterson's coercion contingency is a learning process present in ordinary distressed couples. It is NOT coercive control, and the safety gate must not trip on it — that boundary is the point of this case. 'I am not the one who has to fix everything' satisfies 50-interdependence's self-interest stance (holding to individual outcome, refusing to absorb a cost); coded independently by that module from the same span.
